svg.title: Information Retrieval, Prompt Formulation, and Generation workflow
svg.desc: Inventory: a left-side history/input notation and person icon feed by a right-pointing gray arrow into a three-stage rounded workflow frame. Stage 1 contains a dashed information-retrieval frame with two pastel rounded blocks for filtering and context sample selection. Stage 2 contains a dashed prompt-formulation frame with prompt text and a bottom condition. Stage 3 contains a dashed generation frame with three stacked pastel blocks for next state, next action, and history update; the next-state block includes a small multicolor probability landscape icon. A thick gray loop runs along the bottom with vertical arrows back into stages 1 and 2, labeled Else, condition, and While f<F. Symmetry/equipartition basis: three main columns aligned along a common top title baseline and within one enclosing rounded outer frame; stage 3 inner blocks are vertically stacked with equal left/right margins, while stages 1 and 2 use centered content. SAM mapping: Original Figure Object avatar/person icon - Constructed Element ID draft_avatar - SAM Asset ID asset_sam_region_000015. Original Figure Object multicolor probability landscape in Generate next state - Constructed Element ID draft_chart - SAM Asset ID asset_sam_region_000016.

g.text: Simulate the next state of the target system.
